none: PAS FindID 960021: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, kindly suggested by the finder to be of Allectus (293-296); the reading of the obverse might commend his immediate predecessor Carausius (286-293), Reece period 14. Obverse description: radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: CA[---]VS A[VG]. Reverse description: Galley sailing ?left. Diameter: 19.6mm, Weight: 2.37gms, die axis: possibly 6
